work.author: Origen
work.description: Origen's commentary on the Gospel of Matthew, surviving in books 10-17 in Greek and in a longer Latin version. Book 13, sections 27-28, on Matt. 18:10, asks whether each soul receives its angel at birth or at baptism. A locus is book and section.
work.title: Commentarium in evangelium Matthaei
